name: The Battle Of Evil
detailed_description:
🎮 《The Battle of Evil》 – Epic 2D Side-Scrolling Warfare Where Grit & Strategy Tear Through the Apocalypse! 🔥

【Core gameplay | Highlights | Co-op | Powerful characters】

▌ 4-Player Co-op Mayhem!
Become an elite tactical commander and assemble a squad of unique super-soldiers: Combat Specialists, Genius Ninjas, Astro-Armored Mechs, or Blood Demons. Unleash chaos and blast the evil alien hordes into oblivion!

▌Horizontal level revolution!

Travel through multiple battlefields that subvert your imagination: A highway chase on the way to a seaside town, dodge the killing array in the horror amusement park, dance with medieval demons in the Moonlight City, and even fight tribal gods in the primeval forest!

  • Cooperative fighting mode: up to 4 people on the same screen to fight against evil forces

  • Distinctive character fighting methods: each character has its unique fighting method, rejecting homogenized fighting rhythm and performance methods.

  • Metal Slug-like level-breaking experience: fast-paced, multi-variable, and diversified themed level mechanisms and challenges.

  • Multiple level tasks: each level has a unique theme and level mechanism, terrain changes, traps, and even tracking battles.

  • Brilliant BOSS battle experience: smart enemies increase the fun of in-game challenges

  • Difficulty level: There is a difficulty level, whether you are a video game novice or The difficulty is appropriate for all action game masters.

  • Dynamic difficulty: In multiplayer games, the difficulty will be adjusted according to the number of players present to maintain the balance of the game.

  • Equipment upgrade: After passing the level, you can get points to upgrade the main and secondary weapons and auxiliary equipment of the character. In addition to the strength value, some equipment will change its performance after upgrading.

  • Skill combination: Different equipment has different skills, and the skills are linked to each other to achieve the most variable effects.

  • Action and shooting mixed elements: Smooth movements and hitting feel experience the action elements, while guns and gunpowder show the shooting elements.

short_description: 《The Battle Of Evil》is a pixel-style multiplayer action platform game that combines elements of horizontal scrolling and unique levels. Up to 4 people can fight together. Eliminate major evil organizations and alien armies and use characters' powerful combat skills to beat the evil armies to pieces!
